newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high in upbeat mood.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high in upbeat mood.

text.p: Swedish shares closed at a new high on Friday in an upbeat mood.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.77 percent to 3,072.23 in relatively light trade with shares worth 3.78 billion crowns changing hands.

Bluechips rose, leading the market. Telecoms heavyweight Ericsson closed 3.5 crowns higher at 315, heading for its record level of 317 crowns, while drugs major Astra ended three higher at 150.5 crowns in active trade.
The U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers said it saw Astra shares rising to 160 crowns.
Fellow drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn rose one to 284.5 crowns. Lehman Brothers revised its forecast for earnings per share to $1.80 for 1997.

Household appliance maker Electrolux jumped 26 to 593 crowns. The company said it was eyeing two Swedish plants that could be closed or sold as part of the company's plan to close 25 factories and cut 12,000 staff worldwide.
Insurer Skandia climbed steadily to end 18 crowns higher at 308 crowns. "Dresdner Kleinwort Benson has recently lifted its buying recommendation on the share," one broker said.
